importTransactionCustomScript.functionDescription: The parse function will be called for each row of the parsed file data, and the function name must be 'parse'
importTransactionCustomScript.functionParamRowDescription: An array of string, each element is a column value
importTransactionCustomScript.functionReturnDescription: An object representing a transaction (with the fields defined below), or null to skip this row
importTransactionCustomScript.fieldTimeDescription: [required] Transaction time, format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss. You can also use the parseDateTime(value, format) function to convert a custom formatted time string to the standard format, where 'format' argument is the format of the custom time string, e.g. parseDateTime('12/31/2023 23:59', 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm') means converting '12/31/2023 23:59' to the standard format '2023-12-31 23:59:00'
importTransactionCustomScript.fieldUtcOffsetDescription: [required] Transaction timezone offset in minutes, e.g. '480' for UTC+8, '-300' for UTC-5. You can also use the parseUtcOffset(timezoneName) function to get the timezone offset in minutes automatically according to the transaction time, where 'timezoneName' argument is the IANA time zone name, e.g. parseUtcOffset('Asia/Shanghai') means getting the timezone offset in minutes for Beijing Time
importTransactionCustomScript.fieldTypeDescription: [required] Transaction type, must be one of 'TransactionType.Income', 'TransactionType.Expense' or 'TransactionType.Transfer'
importTransactionCustomScript.fieldDestinationAccountNameDescription: [optional] Destination account name (for transfer type only)
importTransactionCustomScript.fieldSourceAmountDescription: [required] Source amount (including two decimal places expressed without a decimal separator, for example '12345' represents 123.45)
importTransactionCustomScript.fieldDestinationAmountDescription: [optional] Destination amount (for transfer type only, format is the same as the source amount)

importInsightsExplorerQueries.queryIdDescription: [optional] Unique UUID for the query. Must be a valid UUID and unique within the same exploration. If omitted, a UUID is generated automatically.
importInsightsExplorerQueries.conditionDescription: [optional] Omit this field when relation is ")", otherwise it is required
importInsightsExplorerQueries.conditionValueDescription: [required] Match value(s). Depending on the match type, this may be a string, an array of strings, or an array of numbers
importInsightsExplorerQueries.conditionRelationDescription: [required] Logical relationship with the previous condition

dashboard.title: Personal Finance Overview
dashboard.subtitle: See assets, liabilities, actual cash flow, debt plans, and statement coverage in one traceable view.
dashboard.automaticScopeHint: Assets use authoritative formal-account balances; cash flow is aggregated for the selected actual period.

error.load: The financial overview could not be loaded. Refresh and try again.

snapshot.title: Balance-sheet snapshot
snapshot.ledgerNotPlan: Actual ledger value, not a repayment forecast
snapshot.liquidScope: Cash, checking, savings, and virtual accounts

trust.unconfirmedExcluded: Unconfirmed import rows are excluded from balances and cash flow

quick.title: Actual cash flow · {period}
quick.subtitle: Switch periods without changing the formal-ledger classification rules.

debt.title: Debt calendar
debt.subtitle: Planned payments and actual ledger liabilities stay separate, so forecasts never masquerade as facts.

cashFlow.title: Actual cash flow
cashFlow.subtitle: Principal, interest, fees, and consumption are classified separately; internal transfers do not inflate income or spending.
cashFlow.trendSubtitle: Consumption and actual debt service stay separate so principal is never counted as living consumption.
cashFlow.amountsHidden: Amounts and trend shape are hidden
cashFlow.boundary: Amounts stay grouped by currency; cross-currency display uses current rates. An * marks an incomplete total when a rate is missing. Balance adjustments remain separate from income and consumption.

coverage.title: Statement coverage & confidence
coverage.subtitle: See which source accounts are mapped, how far statements reach, and any gaps or overlaps in the reporting period.
coverage.mappedNo: Not mapped to a formal account
coverage.complete: Coverage is continuous for this reporting period.
coverage.incompleteSummary: Statement coverage or import results need review.
coverage.unknownPeriod: The latest usable statement has no explicit period
coverage.empty: No statement source accounts are configured.

gettingStarted.title: Upload statements first, then handle a few todos
gettingStarted.subtitle: You do not need to create accounts by hand first. After upload, the system lists accounts to create or reuse. You can skip the first balance check, but it stays marked unverified.
gettingStarted.accountHint: Create only the new ones; already confirmed accounts are reused by default and can still be changed.
gettingStarted.importsHint: Import Alipay, WeChat Pay, bank, and credit-card statements weekly or monthly.
gettingStarted.reviewHint: Clear transactions post automatically; only exceptions need a decision.
gettingStarted.boundary: Electronic payments do not need day-to-day manual entry. Use “new transaction” for cash, events without electronic evidence, or anything you want to see immediately. After creating an account you may skip the balance check, but it must stay marked unverified.

mobile.title: Financial Overview
mobile.heading: Your position today
mobile.subtitle: Net worth, this month's spending, the next payment due, and a trust line.
mobile.automatic: Formal ledger included automatically through today

headline.nextPaymentHint: The nearest of the next loan installment and a card due date
headline.monthConsumption: This month's living spend, by actual date
headline.trustHint: Unverified balances are never shown as reconciled.
headline.addTransactionHint: Cash or anything you want to see now

organizer.title: Statement Organizer
organizer.subtitle: You do not need to enter every electronic payment by hand. Upload Alipay, WeChat Pay, bank, and credit-card statements; the system organizes them first and asks only about ambiguous items.

billflow.title: This organize task
billflow.subtitle: Move through the steps. You can always go back and change a decision.
billflow.error: The organize task could not finish. Refresh and try again.
billflow.failed: This task stopped because confirmed history conflicts. The difference is kept and nothing is overwritten.
billflow.confirmHint: Finish reviewing transactions and other items, then confirm posting.
billflow.reviewHint: Choose a category for unclear transactions. You can select several and save them together.
billflow.mergeHint: The same purchase matches on merchant/description, amount, currency, and the same card. Credit-card statements only have a date, so the same calendar day is enough. Clear matches merge automatically; otherwise each Alipay row and the matching card-statement row are shown in full on separate lines.
billflow.othersHint: Anything left after categorizing. You can continue if there is nothing to decide.

merge.pending: After accounts are ready, start merging. Clear matches are merged automatically.
merge.empty: Nothing needs a merge decision. Clear matches are already merged, or merging has not started.
merge.mergedEmpty: No merge items have been marked handled yet. Automatic merges are not listed here.
merge.pendingHint: Only rows that did not auto-merge are listed. All statements share one header; each pair is one block of matching rows. Everbright “transaction description” is the counterparty. Item is shown only when it differs from both the counterparty and the order ID. Credit-card rows show the date only. “Processed” means you reviewed it; “Skip for now” leaves it aside.
merge.mergedHint: Items you marked processed or skipped appear here and can be restored. Automatic merges are not asked again.
merge.matchesEmpty: No comparable row from another statement is listed. Automatic merge needs merchant/description, amount, currency, and the same card; credit-card dates match on the same calendar day.
merge.matchesMany: Several nearby rows exist, so it was not merged automatically.

skip.title: Don't post
skip.hint: Check a transaction to keep it out of the ledger. Whole-account ignores are already done when checking accounts.

files.title: Choose statements to organize together
files.emptyHint: Upload Alipay, WeChat Pay, or bank statements first. You can pick more than one.
files.inTask: Choose the statements for this round. You can add or remove them until you confirm posting.
files.inTaskLocked: This round is posted. The statements cannot be changed.

next.accountsReady: Accounts are ready. Continue to review transactions
next.accountsBalance: Next you can note current balances, or skip
next.merge: Merge the same purchase across statements
next.mergeBlocked: {count} cross-statement links still need a decision
next.review: Finish these, then review other items
next.others: Continue to confirm posting even if there are no other items
next.confirm: Nothing enters the ledger until you confirm

accounts.title: Check accounts
accounts.reusedHint: These will be reused for this task. Newly created accounts can note a current balance here, or skip.
accounts.pendingHint: Reuse or create after the name matches. Ignore an account if it is not yours.
accounts.reusedEmpty: No confirmed accounts are being reused.
accounts.excludedHint: These stay as evidence and no ledger account is created. Whole-group ignores are remembered next time and can be undone.
accounts.cardHeaderCreateHint: Creating this card copies the statement day onto the account. Due date and credit limit stay here and are not stored on the account.
accounts.cardHeaderReusedHint: The statement day is stored on the account. Due date and credit limit stay here only.

todos.title: Transaction categories
todos.pendingHint: This list is only what still needs a look, not every imported row. WeChat “merchant payment” is not a category. Choose once; the same merchant is remembered next time.
todos.classifiedHint: Rows the statement already mapped, and categories you just saved, both appear here. WeChat “merchant payment” still needs a choice first.
todos.othersEmpty: No other items need a decision.

todo.unresolved_payment_account: Not mapped to a ledger account yet
todo.core_field_conflict: Amount or direction does not match
todo.cross_source_ambiguous: Could not uniquely match another statement
todo.installment_candidate: This may be an installment; only a few questions first

balance.title: How much is in the new accounts now (optional)
balance.hint: Note about how much is in this new account. The statement is a history; you can skip this.
balance.empty: No new accounts need a balance check. Continue.

mobile.title: Statement organizer
mobile.readOnly: Mobile shows a summary only. Finish organizing on desktop.

loans.eyebrow: Debt agreements and actual ledger effects
loans.title: Loans & Installments
loans.subtitle: Calculate agreements, track the expected schedule, and connect each real principal, interest and fee event without double-counting spending.
loans.selectContractHint: Choose a contract to inspect its schedule, ledger liability and settlement links.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.subtitle: Expected plans and real ledger effects stay separate
contracts.emptyHint: Create a contract or choose another status.

field.name: Contract name
field.percentageHint: Enter a percentage with up to 10 decimal places

calculator.title: Agreement calculator
calculator.subtitle: All three business dates are explicit. Calculating never changes an account balance.

advanced.title: Agreement cost and calculation details
advanced.hint: Expand rates, effective APR, and total-cost details when needed. For everyday use, start with principal left, the next due date, and the repayment plan.

contractForm.title: Contract identity
contractForm.subtitle: Link the agreement to one eligible liability account and an optional asset payment account in the same currency.
contractForm.accountBoundary: Only visible single credit-card/debt accounts can hold the liability; payment accounts must be visible assets in the same currency.

revise.title: Revise calculation
revise.identityLocked: A revision sends only this contract's ID/version and the new calculation input. Name, lender, accounts, currency and status are not editable here.

boundary.calculationIsNotLedger: This calculation is only an expected plan and does not change account balances.
boundary.planIsNotPayment: A due date does not mean payment occurred; only linked real transactions settle a plan.
boundary.principalIsNotExpense: Principal is a transfer from an asset account to the liability account, not an expense.
boundary.combinedPaymentMustBeSplit: A combined debit cannot be virtually split inside the loan plan. Link or create separate principal, interest and fee ledger events.

schedule.differenceHint: May include other card purchases or contracts
schedule.emptyHint: Select a contract to inspect its current immutable schedule.

disbursement.title: Funding and upfront fee
disbursement.hint: The disbursement transfer uses contract principal. The upfront fee is a separate expense; together their asset effect equals the displayed net amount received. Purchase installments never create a disbursement.

settlement.title: Settle with real ledger events
settlement.atomicHint: Selected non-duplicate components are applied together; any failure rolls the whole action back. Existing events are linked for their full amount.
settlement.undoImpactCounts: {allocations} links across {transactions} transactions; {modified} changed or missing
settlement.undoKeepsTransactions: Undo removes only loan relationships. It never deletes formal ledger transactions.
settlement.emptyHint: Select an unsettled row above to link principal, interest and fees.
settlement.draftAmountHint: A new ledger event may be less than the currently outstanding amount.
settlement.categoryRequired: Choose an explicit category for this transaction. No category is selected automatically.
settlement.undoConfirm: Undo only the loan relationships for the last settlement? Formal transactions will remain.

lifecycle.closeHint: Manual close and write-off may retain planned or ledger differences. The server performs the final version and accounting checks.
lifecycle.reopenConfirm: Reopen this closed contract using its current version?
lifecycle.cancelConfirm: Cancel this contract? Cancellation is allowed only when it has no active allocations.

mobile.title: Loans & Installments
mobile.desktopHint: Use the desktop workbench to calculate, edit or settle contracts.

reason.transactionModified: A linked transaction changed and must be reviewed.
reason.transactionMissing: A linked transaction is missing and must be reviewed.
reason.incompleteTransfer: A linked transfer no longer has both sides.
reason.liabilityMismatch: The expected principal and actual account liability differ.
reason.outstandingRemaining: The contract still has an outstanding amount.
reason.generic: The server reported a condition that requires review.

message.actionRequired: The server did not apply this action because the current contract or ledger state requires review.

error.operationFailed: The loan operation could not be completed. Refresh and review the current state before retrying.
error.referenceDataFailed: Accounts or categories could not be loaded. Ledger drafts remain unavailable until they are refreshed.

reconciliation.title: Review duplicates, transfers, and refunds
reconciliation.subtitle: The system finds likely duplicate purchases and transfers between your accounts; you only decide the few ambiguous items.
reconciliation.noCasesHint: Choose a parsed batch to generate candidates, or refresh later.
reconciliation.selectCaseHint: Safe evidence, matching reasons, and persisted human decisions appear here.
reconciliation.noReason: No display-safe candidate reason was returned
reconciliation.evidencePrivacy: Only backend-provided masked summaries are shown. Internal hashes, full source accounts, and raw payloads never enter this view.

evidence.limitReached: More evidence exists for this member; this card shows only the safe summary returned by the backend.

reconciliation.decisionHint: Choose the economic relationship and confirm explicitly. The request carries the current case version and a new idempotency key.
reconciliation.activeDecision: This case has an active decision and its undo impact can be inspected. The response does not include the decision type, so this view does not guess it.
reconciliation.generatedWithLimit: Candidates generated; this bounded scan reached its limit

decisionHintByType.same_event: Multiple source records support one formal transaction.
decisionHintByType.internal_transfer: The records are the funding sides of one internal transfer.
decisionHintByType.refund_reversal: Keep the original and refund as separate events with a relationship.
decisionHintByType.independent: Persist that they do not match, avoiding repeated prompts.
decisionHintByType.defer: Keep the candidate without changing the ledger or source-row state.

reason.identifierMatch: Order or business identifiers are related
reason.textSimilarity: Merchant or item summaries are similar
reason.transactionModified: A formal transaction changed after the decision
reason.transactionMissing: A linked formal transaction is missing
reason.sharedDependency: A formal transaction has another dependency
reason.multipleLedgerEvents: Members already link to different ledger events
reason.loanDependency: A loan or installment plan uses this transaction
reason.otherActiveCase: Another active case still uses this transaction

confirm.title: Confirm Human Decision
confirm.message: Mark this case as “{decision}”. The decision is persisted and will not be silently overwritten by overlapping imports.
confirm.versionNotice: The server checks the current case version. If evidence changed, refresh and review again.

composer.title: Confirm Field Sources and Ledger Handling
composer.privacy: Select only backend-provided masked member summaries. Field-source choices do not copy raw payloads, and draft comments remain empty.
composer.noDraft: A related member already has a formal event, or this decision creates no ledger draft. Only field sources and the relationship are saved.

validation.field_source_required: Explicitly select the account/amount source member and the merchant/description source member.
validation.refund_original_required: Explicitly select the original transaction member for this refund relationship.
validation.evidence_incomplete: Normalized evidence lacks a valid amount, currency, or time, so a safe ledger draft cannot be created.
validation.currency_mismatch: Member currencies differ, so the frontend cannot create a ledger draft.
validation.draft_required: This relationship has no existing formal event. Complete the required ledger draft.
validation.transaction_type_required: The evidence direction is unclear. Explicitly choose income or expense.
validation.category_invalid: Select a valid category matching the transaction type.
validation.account_invalid: Select a valid ledger account matching the evidence currency.
validation.transfer_accounts_must_differ: Internal-transfer source and destination accounts must differ.
validation.refund_types_must_be_opposite: The original transaction and refund must use opposite income/expense types.

outcome.automaticDelete: The case can reopen safely and automatically delete unchanged ledger effects created only by this reconciliation.
outcome.reopenOnly: The case can reopen safely and detach evidence, without deleting any formal transaction.
outcome.actionRequired: The case cannot reopen automatically. Confirmation records an action-required revision without changing balances.

mobile.title: Reconciliation Summary
mobile.readOnly: Mobile is read-only. Decisions and undo actions are unavailable.
mobile.desktopHint: Generate candidates, make decisions, and confirm undo impact on desktop.

error.staleOrFailed: The case may have changed or the operation failed. Refresh and try again.

personalFinance.title: Upload and organize statements
personalFinance.subtitle: Upload electronic statements weekly or monthly. Source evidence is preserved, duplicates are detected, and only a few exceptions need confirmation before posting to the formal ledger.
personalFinance.noHistoryHint: Upload an Alipay, WeChat or bank statement to start a traceable import.
personalFinance.selectBatchHint: Review its summary, row evidence, duplicates and conflicts here.
personalFinance.previewHint: Raw identifiers and storage fields are intentionally excluded from this view.

paymentAccount.title: Confirm statement payment accounts
paymentAccount.subtitle: Each payment method only needs one confirmation per batch.
paymentAccount.scopeHint: The statement source (Alipay or WeChat) is separate from the account actually charged. This only sets the charged ledger account; source identity and duplicate detection stay unchanged.
paymentAccount.existingSuggested: An existing account was suggested from the account name, bank and last digits. Please verify it.
paymentAccount.createHint: The account is created only after you click Confirm and Apply. Its opening balance is zero and can be adjusted later.
paymentAccount.none: No payment accounts need setup in this batch
paymentAccount.batchHint: Confirm once to apply the choice to the same payment method throughout this batch and reuse it in future statements.
paymentAccount.createdComment: Created from a {source} statement after user confirmation

row.newExplanation: This is a new statement transaction that is not yet in the formal ledger. Confirm its category and other ledger fields to post it.
row.duplicateExplanation: The same source identity and economic facts already exist. Confirm the ledger fields; the server reuses a complete existing transaction relationship or creates one if none exists.
row.conflictExplanation: The same source identity has incompatible amount, currency, direction or economic effect. Posting is blocked.
row.reviewExplanation: The evidence is usable but requires explicit human confirmation.
row.nonPostableExplanation: This row is not eligible for posting.
row.invalidExplanation: This row could not be parsed reliably and is preserved only as evidence.
row.linkedExplanation: This evidence is already linked to the formal ledger.

duplicateDialog.title: This statement was uploaded before
duplicateDialog.message: The original file remains unchanged. Open its latest batch, or explicitly create a new immutable parsing batch.

sourceDialog.title: Choose the statement account
sourceDialog.weakEvidence: The statement only contains masked or display-only account evidence. Choose a profile explicitly; the app will not guess an identity.
sourceDialog.noDisplayName: No account display name was found
sourceDialog.noExisting: No active profile for this source
sourceDialog.ledgerMappingHint: Optional. This only pre-fills confirmations and does not change source identity.

genericBank.title: Configure Generic Bank CSV
genericBank.templateNotice: This is a generic template without bank-specific rules. Map it to the file's actual columns.
genericBank.privacyNotice: The column mapping is submitted only with this parse request. Full account numbers and raw fields are not logged by this view.
genericBank.autoDetectionFailed: The statement was not detected automatically. Generic bank CSV setup is now open.
genericBank.sourceHint: Choose or create a bank source profile with a required formal ledger-account mapping.
genericBank.noUsableSourceAccount: No bank profile has a ledger-account mapping
genericBank.unmappedProfiles: {count} other bank profile(s) have no ledger mapping and cannot be used for this import.
genericBank.ledgerRequired: Required. A bank statement must map to a specific ledger account.
genericBank.columnNumberHint: Column numbers in this form start at 1; leave optional columns blank. The header row also starts at 1.
genericBank.amountHint: Choose the one amount structure used by this file. Columns from other modes are not submitted.
genericBank.directionValuesHint: Type a value and press Enter. Case and surrounding whitespace are normalized.
genericBank.optionalColumnsHint: Only map columns that clearly exist and have the stated meaning.

error.header_row_required: The header row must be an integer from 1 to 10000.
error.column_required: Complete every column required by the selected amount mode.
error.column_out_of_range: Column numbers must be integers from 1 to 1024.
error.column_duplicate: A column cannot be mapped to more than one field.
error.direction_values_required: Income and expense direction values are both required.
error.direction_values_invalid: Direction values cannot be empty, duplicated, too long or contain control characters.
error.direction_values_overlap: Income and expense direction values cannot overlap.
error.source_account_required: Choose an active bank source account.
error.ledger_account_required: The bank source account must map to a ledger account.

cebCredit.title: Parse China Everbright Credit Statement
cebCredit.templateNotice: This template is only for China Everbright credit-card PDFs, not a generic bank PDF parser.
cebCredit.privacyNotice: Parsing stays on this machine. This view does not log full account numbers or raw fields.
cebCredit.twoCardHint: Multiple cards in one statement are grouped as Everbright credit cards plus last four digits. Choose the ledger accounts later while organizing.
cebCredit.autoDetectionFailed: The statement was not detected automatically. Everbright credit-statement setup is now open.

posting.title: Confirm Ledger Transaction
posting.noMatchingAccount: No visible ledger account uses {currency}. Create or enable a matching account first.
posting.completed: The selected evidence has been linked to the ledger

evidence.title: Source Evidence
evidence.none: This transaction has no personal-finance source evidence.
evidence.privacyNote: Only normalized, redacted evidence is shown here.

mobile.title: Import History
mobile.readOnly: Mobile view is read-only. Upload and confirmation remain on desktop.
mobile.desktopHint: Use the desktop workbench to upload and confirm statements.

issue.bank_row_column_mismatch: The row has a different number of columns than the header

operations.noAutomaticUndo: This version does not automatically undo formal ledger transactions. Use this read-only impact summary to plan manual handling.
operations.discardConfirm: Discard this unposted batch? It has {pending} pending and {posted} posted rows. Evidence remains available, but this batch cannot be posted afterward.
operations.discarded: The import batch has been discarded
operations.deleteContentConfirm: Delete the original statement bytes? This batch has {pending} pending and {posted} posted rows. File metadata and all evidence remain, but the bytes are not recoverable unless the same file is uploaded again.
operations.contentDeleted: The original statement content has been deleted

dataManagement.clearAllHint: You CANNOT undo this action. Clear All Data also deletes personal-finance source files, import evidence, accounts, categories, tags and transactions. Enter your current password to confirm.

error.operationFailed: Unable to complete the personal finance operation
